xxhash.h: xxHash 0.8.x single header, BSD 2-Clause (Yann Collet), license text at the top of the file.
Used to compute the same texture/palette hashes as PCSX2 (XXH3_64bits) for texture replacement packs.

smaa/AreaTex.h, smaa/SearchTex.h: the lookup tables of SMAA (Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria, Belen Masia,
Fernando Navarro, Diego Gutierrez; https://github.com/iryoku/smaa), MIT licence, text at the top of each file.
The SMAA passes in src/gs_shaders_msl.inc and src/gs_shaders.glsl are a port of the reference implementation.
